<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    size_t pos_at = s.find("at", 1);
    if (pos_at != std::string::npos) {
        s.replace(pos_at, 2, "@");
    }

    size_t pos_dot;
    while ((pos_dot = s.find("dot", 1)) != std::string::npos && pos_dot <= s.length() - 4) {
        s.replace(pos_dot, 3, ".");
    }

    std::cout << s;
    return 0;
}
